chunks: Let not Satan misdirect you. He is your open enemy.
ai.seo_question: Why is Satan considered an open enemy in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *fitrah* (innate disposition), warning that Satan exploits human complacency to sever the connection with the Divine. It underscores the necessity of *muraqabah* (God-consciousness) to recognize Satan's clear enmity and maintain spiritual vigilance against subtle distractions.
